eyebrow: The highest-value test in ML code
code:
def test_loss_decreases_when_overfitting_one_batch():
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    model = build_model(cfg_for_test())
    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3)
    x, y = get_one_fixed_batch()

    losses = []
    for _ in range(50):
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        loss = criterion(model(x), y)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
        losses.append(loss.item())

    assert losses[-1] < losses[0] * 0.1
caption: If a model can't memorize one batch, gradients or wiring are broken -- before a real run proves it slowly.
